speaker: Puddleford
lines: In Puddleford, breakfast falls from the sky.
Grab Nana's old tray. Somebody's hungry.

speaker: Gus
lines: Carrot sticks. Same as always.
Your Nana cut the ends square. Just saying.

mission.text: Gus wants sticks. Ends cut square.

speaker: Crumb
lines: A pigeon lands on the cart, takes one carrot stick, and stays. Coo.

speaker: Crate note
lines: Wash the carrots. They came through a cloud.

mission.text: One tidy day. Nothing extra on the tray.

speaker: Marigold
lines: Four out of ten.
I haven't tasted it yet. I'm saving time.

mission.text: Get Marigold past a four: 2 perfect dishes

speaker: Puddleford
lines: A real diner! A stove! A door that only sticks a little!
Crumb takes the coat hook. Nobody argues.

mission.text: Show the new stove who's boss: 3 perfects

speaker: The Fork
lines: PUDDLEFORD GAZETTE, by The Fork: Two forks. Honest carrots.
You pin it up high. Where Nana would see it, if she came back.

speaker: Crate note
lines: Fry eggs gently. Same goes for people. -- N.
P.S. Not the eggs AND the people. Just be gentle.

mission.text: Two plates of eggs, fried gently. Her rules.

speaker: Crumb
lines: Crumb rings the register. Nobody is paying. He rings it again.

speaker: Sterling Vane
lines: Sterling Vane. I'll buy this diner. And the sky. Ha!
Before the Lid, this town shared ONE turnip. I'm never sharing again.

mission.text: Earn 25 in tips. Vane said you can't.

speaker: Puddleford
lines: Vane storms out, steps in the mop bucket, and storms out slower.

speaker: Crate note
lines: A crate with a big wooden wheel. Painted on it: MANNERS.
Rule 1: feed everyone. Throw food? Spin first. THEN feed. -- N.

payoffs.kick_out: Booted into the hedge. Back in a minute, leaves in hair, asking for the menu.
payoffs.slap: A slap with a wet fish. He blinks, says sorry, orders the soup.
payoffs.fridge: Into the fridge. Out he comes, shivering: 'Something warm, please.'
payoffs.pan: Sizzle, hop, hop, hop. Singed eyebrows. Very polite now.
payoffs.microwave: Ding! Out pops a guest, hair straight up. 'One salad, please.'
payoffs.cook_self: They try to cook it. It catches fire. They eat it anyway, humbly.
payoffs.lock_out: Nose on the glass for an hour. Let back in, fed, very quiet.

mission.text: First soup. The Wheel is watching.

speaker: Rude guest
lines: This soup is WET. SPLAT!
Soup drips off your nose. The Wheel creaks, turns, and points.

mission.text: Somebody needs to cool off. Fridge, then feed.

speaker: Crumb
lines: A calzone on the counter wobbles. Cracks. Crumb hatches out. Coo.

speaker: Gus
lines: Fine. That's Wren's hand. Your Nana's. I promised her: no more.
He leaves his fork standing straight up in the plate. He always does.

mission.text: Four perfects. Cook like she's reading.

speaker: Kid
lines: She's alive. She's up there. She sends carrots.
So why didn't she say goodbye?

speaker: Mr. Notvane
lines: Hello. I am a normal guest with a normal mustache.
The mustache drops into his soup. He eats around it, with dignity.

mission.text: A 'normal guest'. Lock him out, then feed him.

speaker: Sterling Vane
lines: (Megaphone, from his tower) BEHOLD THE SIPHON! ALL SKY FOOD IS MINE!
Feedback squeals. His hat flies off. A crushed can lands on your tray.

mission.text: Cans from his Siphon. Catch 3 orders clean.

speaker: The Fork
lines: THE FORK: Call the place under the cloud Sky Kitchen. Four forks.
Vane & Gleam buys its carrots. Sky Kitchen fights for them. Taste it.

mission.text: The blender's in. First smoothie, no lumps.

speaker: Crumb
lines: Crumb picks fish bones off the tray and files them under 'Vane'.

speaker: Crate note
lines: Someone down there is sucking up my strawberries and sending up cans.
Rude. Keep catching. I'm fine. Mostly. -- N.

mission.text: Five perfects. Turn 'mostly' into 'fine'.

speaker: Marigold
lines: Six out of ten.
Don't cry. I gave my own mother a three.

speaker: Sterling Vane
lines: My compliments to the chef! SPLAT.
Burger, on your face. The Wheel spins. Vane's eyes go very wide.

payoffs.pan: Hop, hop, sizzle. Vane lands outside, smoking gently, and orders fries.

mission.text: He threw a burger. Pan him. Then feed him.

speaker: Nana
lines: Kid. If I let go of the cloud, it drifts. So I couldn't come down.
The tray was my goodbye. You've held it every single day. -- Nana

mission.text: Steak dinner. Cook it for the guest, not her.

speaker: Sterling Vane
lines: Sell me your tray. It's the only one she still aims at.
Why can't I catch anything? I have a FUNNEL. A big one.

mission.text: Six perfects. Let him watch how it's done.

speaker: Puddleford
lines: A cabbage drops into Vane's funnel. Vane is in the funnel. He wears it home.

speaker: Gus
lines: She went up so the whole town would eat. The Lid is her garden.
I promised I'd let you find her yourself. You looked up. Good.

mission.text: Gus orders the fish. He's earned it.

speaker: Crumb
lines: Crumb wears a tiny bow tie now. Nobody gave it to him. Coo.

speaker: Crate note
lines: A blank recipe card. At the top: YOUR DISH.
At the bottom: Not mine. Not for stars. Yours. -- N.

speaker: Sterling Vane
lines: You want ME to cook it? I have STAFF.
Pan on fire. Apron on fire. 'How do you DO this every day?'

payoffs.cook_self: He eats his own burnt toast in silence. Then asks for the recipe.

mission.text: Too fussy? Hand him the pan. Let him learn.

speaker: Puddleford
lines: A pumpkin the size of a bus drops into the Siphon. BLOORP.
Vane's tower fills with soup. Down floats a lady with a striped umbrella.

mission.text: She's at table one. Five clean catches. Breathe.

speaker: Nana
lines: Hello, Kid. Every order you ever cooked was my lesson plan.
Today I'm a guest. I'll have... Your dish.

mission.text: Nana orders 'Your dish.' Make it perfect.

speaker: Marigold
lines: Seven out of ten. Highest I've ever given. Don't frame it.
...You framed it. Fine. Seven and a half.

mission.text: Surf and turf for Marigold. Aim for an eight.

speaker: Crumb
lines: Crumb's tab: 412 fries. Nana pays it with one seed. Crumb accepts.

speaker: The Fork
lines: THE FORK: Five forks. The best table in the sky is on the ground.
The carrot ends were cut square. I checked.

speaker: Kid
lines: Vane's tower is knee-deep in soup. He hasn't eaten in two days.
No stars in it. Nobody watching. Take him the first plate?
Vane eats every crumb. 'Nobody ever brought me a plate before.'
'Is there... a job? I could wash dishes.'
At closing he knocks, soaked. You feed him. Rule one.
He eats every crumb. 'Is there... a job?'

speaker: Gus
lines: Same as always. Ends cut square. ...Thank you, Kid.
His fork stands up in the plate. Tucked under it: a Gazette press card.

mission.text: Eight perfects. Not for stars. For them.

speaker: Nana
lines: The Siphon tore a hole in my cloud. It's raining on my beans.
And who's going to fix it, with my knees?

speaker: Nana
lines: Rooftop Garden. Plant Crumb's seed. And every scrap you toss.
Up here, scraps sprout. Grow it, don't grab it.

mission.text: Grow the garden: 10 perfect dishes.

speaker: Crumb
lines: The seed Nana paid with has sprouted. It's a fry tree. Crumb weeps.

speaker: Sterling Vane
lines: I rebuilt the Siphon as a balloon. It only blows OUT now.
It smells of soup. It is your Balloon Galley. Mind the hatch. Ha!

mission.text: Earn 500 in tips. Altitude makes people kind.

speaker: Nana
lines: My stove, inside the Lid. The Siphon's hole is right there.
Every perfect plate stitches a little cloud back. Get sewing.

mission.text: Stitch the cloud: 12 perfect dishes.

speaker: Puddleford
lines: The mended cloud drifts over Hillbrook. A kid there catches a carrot.
She has a squeaky cart and no idea why food falls. She looks up.

mission.text: Someone's below. 6 clean catches, aim gently.

speaker: Kid
lines: You pack a crate for Hillbrook: a carrot, a dented tray, a card.
Wash the carrots. They came through a cloud. You sign it with one letter.

mission.text: Three chef's cakes for the Top Table.
